title: Design Twitter
prompt:
Design a tiny Twitter:

- `Twitter()`
- `void postTweet(int userId, int tweetId)`
- `List<Integer> getNewsFeed(int userId)` — the 10 most recent tweet ids from the user and everyone they follow, newest first
- `void follow(int followerId, int followeeId)`
- `void unfollow(int followerId, int followeeId)`

Stamp each tweet with a global time; a max-heap over the relevant users' recent tweets pulls the newest 10.
hints: Global counter `time` stamps each tweet so ordering across users is comparable.
Store per-user tweet lists and a follow set per user.
getNewsFeed: gather the recent tweets of self + followees into a max-heap keyed by time, pop up to 10.

solution.explanation: A monotonic timestamp gives a global order across all users' tweets. Because each user's own tweets are already time-sorted, only their last 10 can matter, so the heap merges these short frontiers — a k-way merge that yields the 10 newest without sorting everything.
